steps.name: bend
steps.script:
# Rebuild a bender preset from the layer params: "group__field" keys nest
# back into per-stage blocks. Order goes through --set so bender rejects
# unknown stage ids instead of silently dropping them.
jq -c --argjson seed "$VB_P_SEED" 'reduce (to_entries[] | select(.key | contains("__"))) as $e
  ({version: 1, seed: $seed}; setpath($e.key | split("__"); $e.value))' "$VB_PARAMS" > "$VB_WORK/bender.json"
order=()
if [ -n "${VB_P_ORDER// /}" ]; then order=(--set "order=${VB_P_ORDER// /}"); fi
bend --preset "$VB_WORK/bender.json" "${order[@]}" --seed "$VB_P_SEED" --scanlines "$VB_P_SCANLINES" \
  -o "$VB_OUT" "$VB_IN"

summary: Circuit-bent video hardware via bender-rs (pipelines/bend): each section is one stage of the video path, from camera sensor and tape to frame store, colour encoder, monitor, and feedback loop, broken the way a stray wire would. Defaults are bender's meltdown preset; Presets has the other bundled ones.
